ar: وَصَلِّ وَسَلِّمْ وَبَارِكْ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ وَعَلَى أٰلِهٖ ذَ وِي الْفَضْلِ وَالْإِمْدَادِ .
tr: Wa ṣalli wa sallim wa bārik `alā Sayyidinā Muḥammadin wa `alā Ālihī, Dha wī ‘l-faḍli wa ‘l-imdād.
en: and send prayers upon, salute and bless our Master Muḥammad and his Family those of merit and provision!
blocks.review: ذَ وِي is printed split with a space between ذَ and وِي (transcribed as printed); final yā of وِي carries no visible sukūn. Verifier: confirmed on a01_l — gap after ذَ (~40px) is wider than the non-joining gap in وَ|الْإِمْدَادِ (~19px), so kept split as printed.

ar: اَللَّهُمَّ صَلِّ وَسَلِّمْ وَبَارِكْ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ وَعَلَى أٰلِهٖ أُسْتَاذِ كُلِّ أُسْتَاذٍ .
tr: Allāhumma ṣalli wa sallim wa bārik `alā Sayyidinā Muḥammadin wa `alā Ālihī, Ustādhi kulli ustādh.
en: O Allah send prayers upon, salute and bless our Master Muḥammad and his Family, teacher of every teacher!

ar: وَصَلِّ وَسَلِّمْ وَبَارِكْ عَلَى سَيِّدِنَا مُحَمَّدٍ وَعَلَى أٰلِهِ مَلَاذِ كُلِّ مَلَاذٍ .
tr: Wa ṣalli wa sallim wa bārik `alā Sayyidinā Muḥammadin wa `alā Ālihī, Malādhi kulli malādh.
en: and send prayers upon, salute and bless our Master Muḥammad and his Family the protection of every protector!
